title: State of Rajasthan v. Mahipal Maderna & Malkhan Singh (Bhanwari Devi Murder)
crime_type: Political Abduction / Contract Homicide / Corpse Incineration & Canal Submersion
court_or_authority: Special CBI Court Jodhpur / High Court of Rajasthan
source: Rajasthan High Court Judgment & Indian Kanoon
ipc_sections: Section 364 IPC (Kidnapping in order to murder)
Section 201 IPC (Causing disappearance of evidence of offence)
evidence: Recovered CD recordings containing intimate blackmail videos of minister used by auxiliary nurse Bhanwari Devi
Dredging of Rajiv Gandhi Lift Canal in Jodhpur yielding charred human bone fragments, skull teeth, and Rolex watch
Bat and wooden club weapons discovered submerged along with gunny sack remnants and burnt limestone pit
Confession of contract killer Kailash Jakhar detailing strangulation inside vehicle and burning at Jaloda crater
modus_operandi: Auxiliary nurse attempted to blackmail state cabinet minister and politician with compromising video footage. Politicians hired rural gangster syndicates to lure her under pretense of vehicle purchase. Strangled her inside an SUV, took body to a desolate limestone kiln, burned remains with petrol and wood, crushed bones with wooden bats, and threw ashes into a canal.
personality_disorder: Entrenched political arrogance, machiavellian self-preservation, and total disregard for human worth.
common_traits: Retaliation against political sex-for-favors blackmail recordings
Subcontracting execution to local rural criminal gangs
Multi-stage body destruction (strangulation, burning, pulverizing, water disposal)
Extensive political pressure and coverup attempts
summary: Sensational case exposing collusion between high-level elected political ministers and rural contract killing syndicates. CBI divers dredged canals to recover microscopic bone fragments, resulting in the sacking and lifelong imprisonment of ministers.
